verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֜ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים כָּל־ שֵׁ֧בֶט לֵוִ֛י יִ֠הְיֶה לֹֽא־ חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יֹאכֵלֽוּן׃ אִשֵּׁ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim lak·kō·hă·nîm kāl- šê·ḇeṭ lê·wî yih·yeh lō- ḥê·leq wə·na·ḥă·lāh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl yō·ḵê·lūn ’iš·šê Yah·weh wə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: The Levitical priests indeed the whole tribe of Levi shall have no portion or inheritance with Israel They are to eat the food offerings to the LORD that is their inheritance

verses.original: יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֖וֹ לֹא־ וְנַחֲלָ֥ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ לֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yih·yeh- lōw lō- wə·na·ḥă·lāh bə·qe·reḇ ’e·ḥāw Yah·weh hū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer dib·ber- lōw
verses.literal: Although they have no inheritance among their brothers the LORD . . . [is] their inheritance as He promised them

verses.original: וְזֶ֡ה יִהְיֶה֩ הַכֹּהֲנִ֜ים מֵאֵ֣ת מִשְׁפַּ֨ט הָעָ֗ם מֵאֵ֛ת זֹבְחֵ֥י הַזֶּ֖בַח אִם־ שׁ֣וֹר אִם־ שֶׂ֑ה לַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְנָתַן֙ הַזְּרֹ֥עַ וְהַלְּחָיַ֖יִם וְהַקֵּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh yih·yeh hak·kō·hă·nîm mê·’êṯ miš·paṭ hā·‘ām mê·’êṯ zō·ḇə·ḥê haz·ze·ḇaḥ ’im- šō·wr ’im- śeh lak·kō·hên wə·nā·ṯan haz·zə·rō·a‘ wə·hal·lə·ḥā·ya·yim wə·haq·qê·ḇāh
verses.literal: This shall be the priests’ . . . share from the people . . . who offer a sacrifice whether a bull or a sheep the priests are to be given the shoulder the jowls and the stomach

verses.original: תִּתֶּן־ לּֽוֹ׃ רֵאשִׁ֨ית דְּגָֽנְךָ֜ תִּֽירֹשְׁךָ֣ וְיִצְהָרֶ֗ךָ וְרֵאשִׁ֛ית גֵּ֥ז צֹאנְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: tit·ten- lōw rê·šîṯ də·ḡā·nə·ḵā tî·rō·šə·ḵā wə·yiṣ·hā·re·ḵā wə·rê·šîṯ gêz ṣō·nə·ḵā
verses.literal: You are to give them the firstfruits of your grain new wine and oil and the first wool sheared from your flock

verses.original: כִּ֣י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בָּחַ֛ר ב֗וֹ וּבָנָ֖יו מִכָּל־ שְׁבָטֶ֑יךָ לַעֲמֹ֨ד לְשָׁרֵ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה ה֥וּא בְּשֵׁם־ כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bā·ḥar ḇōw ū·ḇā·nāw mik·kāl šə·ḇā·ṭe·ḵā la·‘ă·mōḏ lə·šā·rêṯ Yah·weh hū bə·šêm- kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: For the LORD your God has chosen [Levi] and his sons out of all your tribes to stand and minister in [His] . . . name for all time

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ הַלֵּוִ֜י יָבֹ֨א מֵאַחַ֤ד שְׁעָרֶ֙יךָ֙ מִכָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ ה֖וּא גָּ֣ר שָׁ֑ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּבָא֙ בְּכָל־ אַוַּ֣ת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ אֶל־ הַמָּק֖וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָֽה׃ יִבְחַ֥ר
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- hal·lê·wî yā·ḇō mê·’a·ḥaḏ šə·‘ā·re·ḵā mik·kāl ’ă·šer- hū gār šām yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇā bə·ḵāl ’aw·waṯ nap̄·šōw ’el- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer- Yah·weh yiḇ·ḥar
verses.literal: Now if a Levite moves from any town . . . vvv vvv of residence throughout Israel and comes in all earnestness . . . to the place - the LORD will choose

verses.original: וְשֵׁרֵ֕ת בְּשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו כְּכָל־ אֶחָיו֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם הָעֹמְדִ֥ים שָׁ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šê·rêṯ bə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw kə·ḵāl- ’e·ḥāw hal·wî·yim hā·‘ō·mə·ḏîm šām lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: then he shall serve in the name of the LORD his God like all his fellow Levites who stand there before the LORD

verses.original: יֹאכֵ֑לוּ חֵ֥לֶק כְּחֵ֖לֶק לְבַ֥ד עַל־ מִמְכָּרָ֖יו הָאָבֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·ḵê·lū ḥê·leq kə·ḥê·leq lə·ḇaḏ ‘al- mim·kā·rāw hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: They shall eat equal portions . . . even though he has received [money] from the sale of his father’s estate

verses.original: כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ בָּ֣א אֶל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ לֹֽא־ תִלְמַ֣ד לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת כְּתוֹעֲבֹ֖ת הַגּוֹיִ֥ם הָהֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’at·tāh bā ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ lō- ṯil·maḏ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇōṯ hag·gō·w·yim hā·hêm
verses.literal: When you enter . . . the land that the LORD your God is giving you do not . . . imitate the detestable ways of the nations there

verses.original: לֹֽא־ יִמָּצֵ֣א בְךָ֔ מַעֲבִ֥יר בְּנֽוֹ־ וּבִתּ֖וֹ בָּאֵ֑שׁ קְסָמִ֔ים קֹסֵ֣ם מְעוֹנֵ֥ן וּמְנַחֵ֖שׁ וּמְכַשֵּֽׁף׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yim·mā·ṣê ḇə·ḵā ma·‘ă·ḇîr bə·nōw- ū·ḇit·tōw bā·’êš qə·sā·mîm qō·sêm mə·‘ō·w·nên ū·mə·na·ḥêš ū·mə·ḵaš·šêp̄
verses.literal: Let no one be found among you who sacrifices his son or daughter in the fire practices divination . . . [or] conjury interprets omens practices sorcery

verses.original: וְחֹבֵ֖ר חָ֑בֶר וְשֹׁאֵ֥ל אוֹב֙ וְיִדְּעֹנִ֔י וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ אֶל־ הַמֵּתִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥō·ḇêr ḥā·ḇer wə·šō·’êl ’ō·wḇ wə·yid·də·‘ō·nî wə·ḏō·rêš ’el- ham·mê·ṯîm
verses.literal: casts spells . . . consults a medium or spiritist or inquires of the dead

verses.original: כִּֽי־ כָּל־ עֹ֣שֵׂה אֵ֑לֶּה תוֹעֲבַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה וּבִגְלַל֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ מוֹרִ֥ישׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- kāl- ‘ō·śêh ’êl·leh ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ū·ḇiḡ·lal hā·’êl·leh hat·tō·w·‘ê·ḇōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā mō·w·rîš ’ō·w·ṯām mip·pā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: - For whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD And because of these detestable things the LORD your God is driving out - [the nations] before you

verses.original: תִּֽהְיֶ֔ה תָּמִ֣ים עִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: tih·yeh tā·mîm ‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: You must be blameless before the LORD your God

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הַגּוֹיִ֣ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ יוֹרֵ֣שׁ אוֹתָ֔ם יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְאַתָּ֕ה אֶל־ מְעֹנְנִ֥ים וְאֶל־ קֹסְמִ֖ים יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃ לֹ֣א נָ֛תַן כֵ֔ן לְךָ֖
verses.transliteration: kî hā·’êl·leh hag·gō·w·yim ’ă·šer ’at·tāh yō·w·rêš ’ō·w·ṯām yiš·mā·‘ū wə·’at·tāh ’el- mə·‘ō·nə·nîm wə·’el- qō·sə·mîm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lō nå̄·ṯan ḵên lə·ḵā
verses.literal: Though these nations which you will dispossess - listen . . . to conjurers . . . and diviners the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so

verses.original: יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ יָקִ֥ים לְךָ֖ נָבִ֨יא כָּמֹ֔נִי מִקִּרְבְּךָ֤ מֵאַחֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּשְׁמָעֽוּן׃ אֵלָ֖יו
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā yā·qîm lə·ḵā nā·ḇî kā·mō·nî miq·qir·bə·ḵā mê·’a·ḥe·ḵā tiš·mā·‘ūn ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: The LORD your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brothers You must listen to him

verses.original: כְּכֹ֨ל אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁאַ֜לְתָּ מֵעִ֨ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בְּחֹרֵ֔ב בְּי֥וֹם הַקָּהָ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹ֣א אֹסֵ֗ף לִשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ קוֹל֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔י וְאֶת־ אֶרְאֶ֥ה לֹֽא־ הַזֹּ֛את הַגְּדֹלָ֥ה הָאֵ֨שׁ ע֖וֹד וְלֹ֥א אָמֽוּת׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- šā·’al·tā mê·‘im Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bə·ḥō·rêḇ bə·yō·wm haq·qā·hāl lê·mōr lō ’ō·sêp̄ liš·mō·a‘ ’eṯ- qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy wə·’eṯ- ’er·’eh lō- haz·zōṯ hag·gə·ḏō·lāh hā·’êš ‘ō·wḏ wə·lō ’ā·mūṯ
verses.literal: This is what - you asked of the LORD your God at Horeb on the day of the assembly when you said Let us not - hear - the voice of the LORD our God - or see this great fire anymore so that we will not die

verses.original: יְהוָ֖ה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלָ֑י דִּבֵּֽרוּ׃ הֵיטִ֖יבוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’ê·lāy dib·bê·rū hê·ṭî·ḇū ’ă·šer
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to me They have spoken well -

verses.original: אָקִ֥ים לָהֶ֛ם נָבִ֨יא כָּמ֑וֹךָ מִקֶּ֥רֶב אֲחֵיהֶ֖ם וְנָתַתִּ֤י דְבָרַי֙ בְּפִ֔יו וְדִבֶּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲצַוֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·qîm lā·hem nā·ḇî kā·mō·w·ḵā miq·qe·reḇ ’ă·ḥê·hem wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḏə·ḇā·ray bə·p̄îw wə·ḏib·ber ’ă·lê·hem ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·ṣaw·wen·nū
verses.literal: I will raise up . . . for them a prophet like you from among their brothers I will put My words in his mouth and he will tell them - everything - I command him

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אָנֹכִ֖י אֶדְרֹ֥שׁ מֵעִמּֽוֹ׃ הָאִישׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יִשְׁמַע֙ אֶל־ דְּבָרַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְדַבֵּ֖ר בִּשְׁמִ֑י
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ā·nō·ḵî ’eḏ·rōš mê·‘im·mōw hā·’îš ’ă·šer lō- yiš·ma‘ ’el- də·ḇā·ray ’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr biš·mî
verses.literal: - And I will hold accountable . . . anyone who does not listen to My words that [the prophet] speaks in My name

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ הַנָּבִ֡יא אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָזִיד֩ לְדַבֵּ֨ר דָּבָ֜ר בִּשְׁמִ֗י אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ צִוִּיתִיו֙ לְדַבֵּ֔ר וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יְדַבֵּ֔ר בְּשֵׁ֖ם אֲחֵרִ֑ים אֱלֹהִ֣ים הַהֽוּא׃ הַנָּבִ֥יא וּמֵ֖ת
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ han·nā·ḇî ’ă·šer yā·zîḏ lə·ḏab·bêr dā·ḇār biš·mî ’êṯ ’ă·šer lō- ṣiw·wî·ṯîw lə·ḏab·bêr wa·’ă·šer yə·ḏab·bêr bə·šêm ’ă·ḥê·rîm ’ĕ·lō·hîm ha·hū han·nā·ḇî ū·mêṯ
verses.literal: But if any prophet - dares to speak a message in My name - that I have not commanded him to speak [or] to speak in the name of other gods that prophet must be put to death

verses.original: וְכִ֥י תֹאמַ֖ר בִּלְבָבֶ֑ךָ אֵיכָה֙ נֵדַ֣ע אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ לֹא־ דִבְּר֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî ṯō·mar bil·ḇā·ḇe·ḵā ’ê·ḵāh nê·ḏa‘ ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer Yah·weh lō- ḏib·bə·rōw
verses.literal: - You may ask in your heart How can we recognize - a message that the LORD has not spoken

verses.original: אֲשֶׁר֩ הַנָּבִ֜יא יְדַבֵּ֨ר בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֗ה הַדָּבָר֙ וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֤ה וְלֹ֣א יָב֔וֹא ה֣וּא הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה לֹ֥א דִבְּר֖וֹ הַנָּבִ֔יא דִּבְּר֣וֹ בְּזָדוֹן֙ לֹא־ תָג֖וּר מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer han·nā·ḇî yə·ḏab·bêr bə·šêm Yah·weh had·dā·ḇār wə·lō- yih·yeh wə·lō yā·ḇō·w hū had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer Yah·weh lō ḏib·bə·rōw han·nā·ḇî dib·bə·rōw bə·zā·ḏō·wn lō- ṯā·ḡūr mim·men·nū
verses.literal: When a prophet speaks in the name of the LORD and the message does not come to pass [or] come true that is a message - the LORD has not spoken The prophet has spoken presumptuously Do not be afraid of him
